```{r}
#load library
library(tidyverse)
#load files
covarFile <- read.csv("/Users/kwaku/Downloads/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")
ExpressionFile <-  read.csv("/Users/kwaku/Downloads/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv",
                            row.names = 1,check.names = FALSE)
GeneNames <- read.csv("/Users/kwaku/Downloads/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")

#check dimensions of each file
dim(covarFile)
dim(ExpressionFile)
dim(GeneNames)

#Clean the Data loaded (CovarFile) with a for loop
cols_to_clean <- c("mat_age_yrs", "preg_preeclampsia", "delivery_gestAge_wks",
                   "sampleCollection_gestAge_wks", "batch_Microarray",
                   "mat_BMI", "mat_vitD", "mat_asthma")

for (col in cols_to_clean) {
  covarFile[[col]] <- sub("^.*: ", "", covarFile[[col]])
}

```

```{r}
#Convert Continuous Variables from text to numeric
ToNumeric <- c("mat_age_yrs", "delivery_gestAge_wks",
                   "sampleCollection_gestAge_wks",
                   "mat_BMI", "mat_vitD")

for (col in ToNumeric) {
  covarFile[[col]] <- as.numeric(covarFile[[col]])
}

# Check for missing values after conversion
colSums(is.na(covarFile[ToNumeric]))

# Convert Categorical variables to factors
covarFile$preg_preeclampsia <- factor(covarFile$preg_preeclampsia,
                                  levels = c("Normal", "Preeclampsia"))
covarFile$mat_asthma        <- factor(covarFile$mat_asthma,
                                  levels = c("0", "1"),
                                  labels = c("No asthma", "Asthma"))
covarFile$batch_Microarray  <- factor(covarFile$batch_Microarray)
covarFile$vitD_status <- ifelse(covarFile$mat_vitD < 20, "Low", "Adequate")
covarFile$vitD_status <- factor(covarFile$vitD_status, levels = c("Low", "Adequate"))




```

```{r}
#Get the gene of interest
my_gene  <- "RRAGD"

# Use the linker file to find the probe ID for this gene
my_probe <- as.character(GeneNames$PROBEID[GeneNames$GENE == my_gene])
my_probe

# Pull that probe's row out of the expression data
gene_df <- data.frame(
  geoID      = colnames(ExpressionFile),
  expression = as.numeric(unlist(ExpressionFile[my_probe, ]))
)


# Check the result
head(gene_df)
nrow(gene_df)


```
```{r}
#Combine gene and covariates
# Check that every sample in covar is in the expression data
all(covarFile$geoID %in% gene_df$geoID)   

# Check that no sample ID appears twice
any(duplicated(covarFile$geoID))  

# Join them by the sample ID
df <- merge(covarFile, gene_df, by = "geoID")

# spot check if data matches
df$expression[df$geoID == "GSM2264363"]
ExpressionFile[my_probe, "GSM2264363"]
# Find each participant's ID in the original expression file
matched_index <- match(df$geoID, colnames(ExpressionFile))

# Display both IDs and the matched expression value
matching_table <- data.frame(
  Covariate_ID = df$geoID,
  Expression_ID = colnames(ExpressionFile)[matched_index],
  RRAGD = df$expression
)


# Check the result
nrow(df)                   
sum(is.na(df$expression)) 
head(df)

```


```{r}
#Plot histogram with ggplot
ggplot(df, aes(x = expression)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "RRAGD expression (log2 intensity)",
       y = "Number of samples",
       title = "Distribution of RRAGD expression") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

# Keep nonmissing expression values
expression_values <- df$expression[!is.na(df$expression)]

# Summarize the histogram numerically
expression_summary <- data.frame(
  N = length(expression_values),
  Mean = mean(expression_values),
  SD = sd(expression_values),
  Median = median(expression_values),
  Min = min(expression_values),
  Max = max(expression_values)
)


```
```{r}
#Plot  scatterplot with ggplot
ggplot(df, aes(x = mat_BMI, y = expression)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "orange") +
  labs(x = "Maternal BMI (kg/m^2)",
       y = "RRAGD expression (log2 intensity)",
       title='RRAGD Expression and Maternal BMI') +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

#Correlation coefficient
cor(df$mat_BMI, df$expression)

```
```{r}
#Plot  boxplot by both categorical variables(Vitamin D status and Pregnancy Outcome)
ggplot(df, aes(x = preg_preeclampsia, y = expression, fill = vitD_status)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Pregnancy outcome",
       y = "RRAGD expression (log2 intensity)",
       fill = "Vitamin D status") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

**SUBMISSION 2**

```{r}

#build one data frame with all 3 genes
# List of genes to analyse
genes_of_interest <- c("RRAGD", "ATG101", "PCSK7")

# Start with the cleaned covariates (including vitD_status)
df <- covarFile

# For each gene: find its probe, extract its expression, and add it as a new column
for (g in genes_of_interest) {

  # Find the probe ID for this gene
  probe <- as.character(GeneNames$PROBEID[GeneNames$GENE == g])

  # Pull out that probe's expression values for every sample
  gene_df <- data.frame(
    geoID = colnames(ExpressionFile),
    value = as.numeric(unlist(ExpressionFile[probe, ]))
  )

  # Name the column after the gene
  names(gene_df)[2] <- g

  # Join to the main data frame by sample ID
  df <- merge(df, gene_df, by = "geoID")
}
df
```

```{r}
#function for the histograms
make_plot_histogram <- function(data, gene, cont_var, cat_var1, cat_var2) {

  # Copy the chosen gene into a column called "expression"
  data$expression <- data[[gene]]

  #histogram
  p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = expression)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
    labs(x = paste(gene, "expression (log2 intensity)"),
         y = "Number of samples") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14)

  print(p1)
}
#run a loop through the genes of interest
for (g in genes_of_interest){
  make_plot_histogram(df, g , "mat_BMI", "preg_preeclampsia", "vitD_status")
}

```

```{r}
#function for the scatterplot
make_plot_scatter <- function(data, gene, cont_var, cat_var1, cat_var2) {

  # Copy the chosen gene into a column called "expression"
  data$expression <- data[[gene]]
  data$cont       <- data[[cont_var]]
  data$cat1       <- data[[cat_var1]]
  data$cat2       <- data[[cat_var2]]
  
 #scatterplot
  p2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = cont, y = expression)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "orange") +
    labs(x = "Maternal BMI (kg/m^2)",
         y = paste(gene, "expression (log2 intensity)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14)

print(p2)}

#run a loop through the genes of interest
for (g in genes_of_interest){
  make_plot_scatter(df, g , "mat_BMI", "preg_preeclampsia", "vitD_status")}
```
```{r}
#function for the boxplot
make_plot_boxplot <- function(data, gene, cont_var, cat_var1, cat_var2) {

  # Copy the chosen gene into a column called "expression"
  data$expression <- data[[gene]]
  data$cont       <- data[[cont_var]]
  data$cat1       <- data[[cat_var1]]
  data$cat2       <- data[[cat_var2]]
  


#boxplot by both categorical variables
  p3 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = cat1, y = expression, fill = cat2)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(x = cat_var1,
         y = paste(gene, "expression (log2 intensity)"),
         fill = cat_var2) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14)
  
  print(p3)
}
#run a loop through the genes of interest
for (g in genes_of_interest){
  make_plot_boxplot(df, g , "mat_BMI", "preg_preeclampsia", "vitD_status")}
  
```
